snippet.title: Simon Says (Magnavox Odyssey) 1972
snippet.description:
The Magnavox Odyssey is the first commercial home video game console. The hardware was designed by a small team led by Ralph H. Baer at Sanders Associates, while Magnavox completed development and released it in the United States in September 1972.

Simon Says is the classic game for pre-schoolers that develops hand and eye coordination, and helps children learn to identify parts of the body with the associated printed word. (For 2 or 3 players).

The Odyssey console includes this game using the game card 2, the overlay and 28 Simon Cards in Total. 

Two players must race to touch the body part of their chosen character's picture when the third player tells them to, based on a deck of Simon Says cards.

Simon turns over the first card from the deck and announces, “Simon Says, go to your elbow." Player one and player two go to their elbows. The first player to reach the elbow, wins the “elbow” card. If SIMON determines that there is a tie, the card is placed at the bottom of the deck.

If "Simon" does not say "Simon Says,” the players are not to move. If a player does move, he must return a “Simon Says” card to the deck, Play continues until the entire deck has been used.

The player who collects the most cards wins the game.

Source: https://archive.org/details/OdySim/page/46/mode/2up

Gameplay: OdySim Simulator 1080p 60 FPS.
